rooms.name: Open rear basement area
rooms.description: One open area beyond the last pair of side rooms. Its side walls flare out at 45 degrees from the corridor, with no entrance partition or doorway. The west outside door opens directly into this space.

rooms.description: Room beneath the west main range, beside the lower front-door corridor.

rooms.name: Reception basement room
rooms.description: Western room beneath Reception, retaining its north doorway and connecting east through the new partition door.

rooms.name: East Reception basement room
rooms.description: Eastern part of the Reception basement, divided along the owner-marked line by a full-height wall with a central doorway.

rooms.name: Reception upper west room
rooms.description: Two straight-facing sashes and one 45-degree west corner sash, matching the circled upper exterior bay. Opens from the shared landing.

rooms.name: Reception upper east room
rooms.description: One straight-facing sash and one 45-degree east corner sash, matching the circled upper exterior bay. Opens from the shared landing.

corridors.name: Rear cross-range corridor
corridors.description: Runs along the rear exterior wall of the main range, bending through the rear bays and wing junctions. Rooms extend toward the front wall.

corridors.name: West rear corridor
corridors.description: Along the outer west wall; room doors are on the east side.

corridors.name: Central rear corridor
corridors.description: Along the east courtyard wall; follows the widened rear section and reaches F2 upstairs.

corridors.name: East rear corridor
corridors.description: Along the outer east wall; room doors are on the west side.

corridors.name: West forward corridor
corridors.description: Along the Reception-facing side of the forward wing, following its stepped width.

corridors.name: East forward corridor
corridors.description: Along the Reception-facing side of the forward wing; a short lobby reaches the existing side doors.

corridors.name: West rear stair lobby
corridors.description: Crosses the rear stair block to the actual court-facing fire-escape doorway.

corridors.name: East rear stair lobby
corridors.description: Crosses the rear stair block to the actual court-facing fire-escape doorway.

corridors.name: West outer doorway lobby
corridors.description: Serves R17 beside the west exterior wall on both levels. D2 opens outside on the ground floor.

corridors.name: West front escape lobby
corridors.description: Reaches the relocated F4 door on the inner return of the E-shaped west pavilion.

corridors.name: West forward doorway lobby
corridors.description: Connects D4 through the ground-only glazed extension.

corridors.name: West forward escape lobby
corridors.description: Turns through a short lobby and follows the west wall to F5 above the masonry return staircase.

corridors.name: East forward doorway lobby
corridors.description: Reaches the east-side F6 doors on both levels.

corridors.name: East court escape lobby
corridors.description: Serves R29 along the east side of the pavilion on both levels. F7 opens onto the fire escape on the first floor only.

corridors.name: East outer doorway lobby
corridors.description: Reaches D8 at the outer east doorway.

corridors.name: West pavilion vestibule

corridors.name: West garden doorway lobby
corridors.description: D3 opens onto the west front garden.

corridors.name: East garden doorway lobby
corridors.description: D7 opens onto the east front garden.

corridors.description: D9 opens into the existing recessed courtyard beside the forward wing.

corridors.name: East corner doorway lobby

corridors.name: West outer door approach
corridors.description: Ground-floor branch to D2.

corridors.name: East court fire door approach
corridors.description: First-floor branch to F7.

corridors.name: West court door lobby
corridors.description: Short connection from the rear corridor to the existing west courtyard door.

corridors.name: Basement central corridor

corridors.name: Basement frontage corridor
corridors.description: Connects S5 and the central basement corridor to the west frontage lower door.

corridors.name: Basement Reception door lobby
corridors.description: Connection to the existing lower door beside Reception.

corridors.name: Reception second-floor landing
corridors.description: Open landing beside the guarded Reception stairwell, turning into the short corridor serving both upper rooms.

stairs.name: Former R24 Reception stair
stairs.description: Square open-well Reception stair connecting basement, ground, first and second floors, with continuous guarded landings.

stairs.name: West rear internal stair
stairs.description: Proposed internal stair at the photographed rear stair section, next to F1. Connects the two playable levels.

stairs.name: East rear internal stair
stairs.description: Proposed internal stair at the photographed rear stair section, next to F3. Connects the two playable levels.

stairs.name: West junction stair
stairs.description: New return stair at the marked red X, connecting the west basement, ground floor and first floor.

exits.name: West rear fire escape
exits.description: E → matching landing of the existing iron fire escape in the west inner rear court. The lower door is already raised above outside ground.

exits.name: Central rear fire escape
exits.description: E → upper landing on the east side of the central rear arm. The exterior has windows on the end wall and no ground-floor door here.

exits.name: East rear fire escape
exits.description: E → matching landing of the existing iron fire escape in the east inner rear court.

exits.name: West front pavilion fire escape
exits.description: E → the wall-side deck connected to the middle landing of the relocated iron return stair. Door is on the inner side wall of the west E-shaped pavilion. The additional 8.5-high door belongs to a third storey and is outside this two-floor proposal.

exits.name: West forward end stair
exits.description: E → the upper landing of the existing masonry return stair at the south end of the west forward wing. There is no matching lower door on this end wall.

exits.name: East forward side fire escape
exits.description: E → outside the lower side door on the ground floor, or onto the iron stair landing on the first floor.

exits.name: East pavilion courtyard fire escape
exits.description: E → the middle wall-side deck connected to the existing zigzag fire escape. Door is on the recessed north-facing corner. The 8.5-high door is outside this two-floor proposal.

exits.name: Reception main entrance
exits.description: E ↔ Reception doorstep and split stone entrance stairs. First-floor portico is not treated as a walkable exit.

exits.name: West outer entrance
exits.description: E ↔ west entrance path towards Parsons Lane.

exits.name: West front garden door
